_doc: Gesture spec for the processional hero idle at 144 px, round R3 (tools/art-construct/figure_r3.py). Starts from idle_hero_r2 (its thumbnail t7: weight on the far leg, hand on the far hip, the chest and head leaning 2 px toward the glaive) and changes: the R3 painted head (faces/r3, the round-3 smile), the hair tail as clumps (render.r3_tail), and a thumbnail round on attitude (below). Units as the C1/R1/R2 specs: h = px above the sole, dx = px from the body centre at the feet (+ = the facing side). Every number is [I] until the learning log (ART-RULES 10, round R3) records it.
name: idle_hero_r3

zones._doc: polygons in dx/h (the checker converts). keep_out: nothing of the named kind may be inside. must_be: the named thing must be there.

keep_out.name: between the eyes below the lash

_tilt_doc: tilt_deg = angle of the near->far line; + = the far (screen-right) side higher. Weight on the far leg: far hip up (+), shoulders the other way (-).

thumbnails.name: t0_r2pose
thumbnails.idea: the incumbent: the R2 hero pose (demure stance, feet about 24 px apart) with the R3 head
thumbnails.verdict: KEPT as #2 (13/13): the incumbent R2 pose, the alternative if the stance reads too casual in motion; beside t7 at x3 its legs are two columns [visible]

thumbnails.name: t1_wide
thumbnails.idea: a wider stance: the free (near) foot steps 8 px out toward the staff (feet about 32 px apart), its knee bent, the glaive butt moved out with it (refs 07/08/09 stand 44-57 px apart; FG-P15 allows 20-30 only with a bent free knee)
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#4, 12/13): FG-P10 (free knee bent 2 deg: a spread heel on the ground straightens the IK leg), and moving the butt 8 px out straightened the grip arm into R2's rejected flag-holder reach [M; visible]

thumbnails.name: t2_hip
thumbnails.idea: one step more contrapposto (FG-N09): the hip rides 2 px further out over the weight leg, pelvis tilt 7 -> 10 deg, shoulders -7 -> -9 deg
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#7, 11/13): FG-P09 (the hip tilt 10 deg against shoulders -9 overshoots the 2-4 px drop) and FG-P10 (weight leg 5.2 deg); by eye a sway, as R2's t5 found [M; visible]

thumbnails.name: t3_head
thumbnails.idea: the head cocked further toward the viewer: chin 2 px toward the facing side, the neck set back 1 px more (FG-P12 toward the top of 5-15 deg)
thumbnails.verdict: dropped on the full build: first scored #1 (11/11 on the silhouette rules), but the hero build failed CL-P05 (block: the chin covers 2 px of the collar cross) and FG-P12 (the neck follows the chin: 4.1 deg); R2's t7 found the same. Re-scored with CL-P05 and FG-P12 added to the thumbnail score: 11/13 [M]

thumbnails.name: t4_toe
thumbnails.idea: the free heel lifted 3 px more and the knee bent further (the toe pointed): the cute idle beat
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#3, 12/13): FG-P10, the free knee bends 41 deg (over 30): at x3 a coy knee-in, not the priestess [M; visible]

thumbnails.name: t5_wide_hip
thumbnails.idea: t1 + t2: the wider stance with the pushed hip
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#8, 11/13): carries both t1's straight knee and t2's overshoot [M]

thumbnails.name: t7_wide_bent
thumbnails.idea: t1's idea done again: the free foot 5 px out (feet about 29 px apart, the top of FG-P15's demure range), the heel lifted so the knee bends (a spread heel on the ground straightens the IK leg: t1 bent 2 deg), the glaive butt only 5 px out so the grip arm keeps its bend
thumbnails.verdict: KEPT, HERO (#1, 13/13, gap 378 px2, width 97, feet 29): the near foot steps 5 px out with its heel lifted and knee bent (10-30 deg), the butt 5 px out; at x3 and 1x the legs stop reading as two columns and the pose steps toward the staff, inside DESIGN 1's 20-30 px demure stance. The first try (heel height 10) bent the knee 32 deg (FG-P10) [M; visible]

thumbnails.name: t8_head_wide
thumbnails.idea: t3 + t7: the cocked head with the wider bent stance
thumbnails.verdict: first picked as the hero (11/11, the most attitude by eye), then dropped for t3's two fails on the full build (CL-P05 block, FG-P12); the stance half of it is t7 [M]

thumbnails.name: t6_control
thumbnails.idea: negative control: level shoulders and hips, both knees straight, glaive 6 deg (the round-4 mannequin); must score last
thumbnails.verdict: the mannequin control scored last (6/13: FG-P08, FG-P09, FG-P10, FG-N04, GR-P09, GR-P10, GR-N02), as it must: the score still catches the round-4 stance [M]

_decisions: round R1 (2026-09-29): six thumbnails built with the final R1 part models and scored on 11 silhouette rules; t2_hiphand (#1) and t5_hip_haft24 (#2) kept; the hero is t2. The collar hand DESIGN 1 names fails FG-N04 once the bell sleeves are at DESIGN size (the drape closes the window and covers the chest window); that is listed for Dex in DESIGN 13 and logged in ART-RULES 10 (R1).
round R2: thumbnail t7_lean_soft kept as the hero (ART-RULES 10, R2).
round R3: see thumbnails below and ART-RULES 10, round R3.
_hero: t7_wide_bent (thumbnail round R3; t8 was the first pick and failed CL-P05 and FG-P12 on the full build: ART-RULES 10, round R3)
_thumb_doc: R3 round on attitude: each thumbnail changes one axis against the R2 hero pose (t0), and t6 is the mannequin control that must score last. Scored on FP.THUMB_RULES (11 silhouette rules) and judged at 2x and 1x beside refs 07, 08, 09. Every set carries the R2 body (head chin_dx 15, neck back 6, the R2 near leg, butt -15) so the round reproduces after t8 was folded into the base.
